

The test constructs `Character character;` with no arguments, so the struct needs a generating default constructor (uninitialized ints would fail the range checks):

<tool_call>
<function=write>
<parameter=content>
#pragma once

namespace dnd_character {

int modifier(int score);
int ability();

struct Character {
    Character();
    int strength;
    int dexterity;
    int constitution;
    int intelligence;
    int wisdom;
    int charisma;
    int hitpoints;
};

}  // namespace dnd_character

</parameter>
<parameter=path>
dnd_character.h
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
<tool_call>
<function=edit>
<parameter=content>
Character::Character() {
    strength = ability();
    dexterity = ability();
    constitution = ability();
    intelligence = ability();
    wisdom = ability();
    charisma = ability();
    hitpoints = 10 + modifier(constitution);
}

</parameter>
<parameter=path>
dnd_character.cpp
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
